name: 丽江
description: Lijiang is a picturesque city in northwestern Yunnan province, famous for the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Lijiang Old Town with its Naxi architecture and canal system. Nestled between the Himalayas and Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, it offers stunning natural scenery including Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and the peaceful beauty of Lugu Lake. Home to the Naxi, Bai, Yi, and other ethnic minorities with rich cultural traditions.
highlights: Lijiang Old Town - UNESCO World Heritage
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain - Stunning peaks
Shaxi Ancient Town - Authentic Naxi culture

climate.tips: Spring and autumn are best with mild weather and clear skies. Summer is rainy but lush green. Winter is dry and sunny but cold at night. UV is very strong year-round due to altitude. Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is cold even in summer - bring layers.

restaurants.name: 纳西妈妈家
restaurants.description: Traditional Naxi family-run restaurant with authentic home-cooked dishes and warm atmosphere in old town alley.
restaurants.address: M Street, Lijiang Old Town
restaurants.tips: Best for authentic Naxi food experience. The family is very welcoming. Try the 'Naxi combo' set meal. Arrive before 7pm for dinner.

restaurants.name: 牦牛肉火锅城
restaurants.description: Famous restaurant specializing in yak meat hotpot and grilled yak meat dishes, using local highland yaks.
restaurants.address: New City Area, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Yak meat is lean and healthy. The hotpot broth is delicious. Share a hotpot between two people. Reservation recommended for dinner.

restaurants.name: 古城小吃街
restaurants.description: Night market in old town with various Yunnan and Lijiang local snacks including grilled meats, noodles, and sweets.
restaurants.address: Near Sifang Street, Lijiang Old Town
restaurants.tips: Great for trying variety of snacks. Sample a bit of everything. Bring tissue - no napkins often. Watch hygiene - pick stalls with locals. Cash preferred.

restaurants.name: 腊排骨火锅
restaurants.description: Iconic Lijiang dish featuring fermented pork ribs (la pai gu) slow-cooked in broth with local vegetables.
restaurants.address: Old Town and New Town locations
restaurants.tips: The signature Lijiang dish - must try. Many restaurants serve it - ask locals for recommendations. The broth is salty - dilute with water. Feeds 2-3 people per pot.

restaurants.name: 高原青稞屋
restaurants.description: Tibetan restaurant serving highland barley noodles, yak butter tea, and traditional Tibetan dishes in cozy atmosphere.
restaurants.address: Near Black Dragon Pool, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Good introduction to Tibetan cuisine. The butter tea is an acquired taste - try it. The hotpot is milder than Sichuan style. Good for cold nights.

restaurants.name: 纳西古乐宴
restaurants.description: Dinner with traditional Naxi ancient music performance, combining authentic local cuisine with cultural experience.
restaurants.address: Old Town venues
restaurants.tips: Book through hotel or tourist info. More expensive than regular dining but includes show. Arrive on time for performance. Good for first-time visitors.

restaurants.name: 花鸟市场小吃
restaurants.description: Local market serving authentic Lijiang breakfast foods and snacks, popular with locals since dawn.
restaurants.address: Flower and Bird Market, New City
highlights: Soy milk and youtiao (fried dough sticks)
restaurants.tips: Best for breakfast. Arrive before 9am for freshest items. Very local - English menu unlikely. Great photo opportunities of market life.
dishHighlights: Soy milk and youtiao (fried dough sticks)

restaurants.name: 丽江咖啡馆
restaurants.description: Western-style cafe near old town serving coffee, pastries, and light meals. Popular with expats and tourists.
restaurants.address: Wuyi Street, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Good for breakfast when tired of Chinese food. The apple pie is excellent. WiFi and charging available. Popular with digital nomads.

restaurants.name: 野生菌火锅
restaurants.description: Premium wild mushroom hotpot using seasonal varieties from Yunnan highlands, served with safety certification.
restaurants.address: New City, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Only during mushroom season (June-Nov). Price varies by mushroom type. The restaurant verifies mushroom safety. Reservation required.

restaurants.name: 纳西阁
restaurants.description: Upscale Naxi restaurant in traditional courtyard setting serving refined local cuisine with elegant presentation.
restaurants.address: Old Town, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Best for special occasions. The courtyard setting is beautiful. Book window seats for atmosphere. Good wine selection.

restaurants.name: 桥头米线
restaurants.description: Local favorite for rice noodles (mi xian) in rich broth, famous in Lijiang for generous portions and fresh ingredients.
restaurants.address: Near Black Dragon Bridge, Old Town
restaurants.tips: Popular with locals - line up at lunch. Quick and cheap. The beef noodle is good. Open only until 2pm - plan accordingly.

restaurants.name: 丽江烧烤一条街
restaurants.description: Street lined with BBQ vendors serving grilled meats, vegetables, and skewers in casual outdoor setting.
restaurants.address: Near New City, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Best after dark. Try various skewers - order small amounts. Local Lijiang beer (Lijiang pijiu) is good. Informal and fun atmosphere.

restaurants.name: 丝绸之路餐厅
restaurants.description: Restaurant serving Muslim-influenced cuisine from China's northwest, including hand-pulled noodles and lamb dishes.
restaurants.address: New City, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Good alternative to Yunnan food. The hand-pulled noodles are freshly made. No pork - Muslim restaurant. Large portions.

restaurants.name: 云雪岭餐厅
restaurants.description: Modern Yunnan fusion restaurant using local ingredients with contemporary cooking techniques in elegant setting.
restaurants.address: Old Town, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Good when seeking refined dining. The presentations are Instagram-worthy. Book rooftop tables for old town views. Pricey but quality.

restaurants.name: 玉龙山脚下农家乐
restaurants.description: Farm restaurant at foot of Jade Dragon Mountain serving fresh vegetables, free-range chickens, and local specialties.
restaurants.address: Near Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
restaurants.tips: Best combined with mountain visit. The chicken is excellent. The view of mountain from table is special. Ask locally for directions.

restaurants.name: 妈妈餐厅
restaurants.description: Simple home-style restaurant run by local Naxi family, serving honest home-cooked food without tourist markups.
restaurants.address: Old Town alley, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Hidden in old town alleys - explore to find. The family doesn't speak much English. Point at what others are eating. Authentic local experience.

restaurants.name: 丽江火锅王
restaurants.description: Popular hotpot restaurant combining Sichuan-style and local Lijiang broths with quality meat and vegetable selections.
restaurants.address: New City Area
restaurants.tips: Very popular with locals. All-you-can-eat is good value on weekends. The dual-flavor pot is recommended. Bring appetite.

restaurants.name: 古城茶馆
restaurants.description: Traditional Naxi teahouse in old town courtyard serving Yunnan pu'er tea, flower tea, and light snacks.
restaurants.address: Old Town courtyard
restaurants.tips: Good for afternoon rest. The pu'er is authentic Yunnan tea. Sit in courtyard for atmosphere. Ask for tea tasting flight.

restaurants.name: 藏民人家
restaurants.description: Authentic Tibetan-run restaurant serving highland cuisine including tsampa, yak meat, and barley wine.
restaurants.address: Near Jade Dragon Mountain
restaurants.tips: Best after Snow Mountain visit. The Tibetan family is very welcoming. Try tsampa with yak butter. The yak meat stew is hearty.

restaurants.name: 丽江腊排骨大王
restaurants.description: The most famous restaurant for Lijiang's signature cured pork ribs hotpot, known for authentic recipe and quality ingredients.
restaurants.address: Old Town, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Best known for cured pork ribs hotpot. The broth is salty - dilute with water. Share pot between 2-3 people. Arrive early to avoid queues.

restaurants.name: 丽江菌菇苑
restaurants.description: Premium wild mushroom hotpot restaurant with seasonal varieties from Yunnan highlands, safety-certified and quality guaranteed.
restaurants.address: New City, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Only open during mushroom season. Book in advance. Ask about today's mushroom selection. Price varies by mushroom type.

restaurants.name: 丽江天台咖啡馆

restaurants.tips: Best for sunset views. Arrive early to claim rooftop seats. Good WiFi for digital nomads. Popular with expats and tourists.

restaurants.name: 酥油茶馆

restaurants.tips: Good introduction to Tibetan culture. The butter tea is salty - acquired taste. Try tsampa with honey. Very authentic experience.

restaurants.name: 古城早餐店
restaurants.description: Local breakfast spot serving authentic Naxi morning dishes including soybean milk, fried dough sticks, and steamed buns.
restaurants.address: Old Town, Lijiang
restaurants.tips: Best breakfast in old town. Opens very early. Very local - English menu unlikely. Great for authentic local experience.

restaurants.name: 纳西婆婆厨房

culturalTips.title: Naxi Culture
culturalTips.content: Lijiang is home to the Naxi people, who have a unique Dongba culture, including the world's only pictographic script still in use. Dongba culture emphasizes harmony between humans and nature.

culturalTips.title: Mosuo Walking Marriage Culture
culturalTips.content: The Mosuo people live around Lugu Lake and maintain the 'walking marriage' tradition of their matriarchal society. Visitors should respect this culture and not view it with curiosity or sensationalism.

culturalTips.title: Old Town Visiting Etiquette
culturalTips.content: Lijiang Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage site. Please keep quiet during your visit and do not smoke indoors. The old town has many wooden structures, so fire safety is crucial. Some areas require tickets for entry.

culturalTips.title: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Sacred Mountain
culturalTips.content: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is a sacred mountain for the Naxi people, regarded as a staircase to heaven. Please respect local religious beliefs and avoid loud noises or disrespectful behavior on the mountain.

culturalTips.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge Hiking Etiquette
culturalTips.content: Tiger Leaping Gorge is one of the deepest canyons in the world. When hiking, please stay on designated trails and do not venture into undeveloped areas. Pay attention to rockfall warning signs and prioritize safety.

culturalTips.title: Dongba Script
culturalTips.content: Dongba script is currently the only pictographic script widely used in the world. You can learn to write your own name as a souvenir. Dongba culture experiences are available in many places in the old town.

culturalTips.title: Naxi Ancient Music
culturalTips.content: Naxi ancient music has a history of over a thousand years, performed by local elders. Performances are held every evening in the old town, offering a great opportunity to learn about Naxi culture.

culturalTips.title: High-Altitude UV Rays
culturalTips.content: Lijiang is at an altitude of 2,400 meters, with intense UV radiation. Even on cloudy days, apply sunscreen, wear sunglasses and a hat. The plateau is dry, so drink plenty of water.

culturalTips.title: High-Altitude Sickness Prevention
culturalTips.content: Lijiang's altitude is relatively high (2,400 meters), and you may experience mild altitude sickness upon arrival. Rest more, avoid strenuous activity, and drink plenty of water. Symptoms may be more pronounced when heading to the snow mountain.

culturalTips.title: Tea Horse Road
culturalTips.content: Lijiang was once an important hub on the Tea Horse Road, where caravans traveled to Tibet and Southeast Asia. Remnants of this caravan culture can still be seen in the old town.

culturalTips.title: Naxi food culture
culturalTips.content: Naxi cuisine tends to be spicy and often features preserved foods. Cured pork ribs are a famous Lijiang dish, and rice sausage is also a specialty. Don't miss the local wild mushroom hotpot (during the rainy season).

culturalTips.title: Photography etiquette
culturalTips.content: Ask for permission before photographing locals or their ethnic attire. Naxi elders, especially Dongba priests, sometimes don't like being photographed. Also ask before taking pictures of mountain prayer flags and white stupas.

culturalTips.title: Ancient city water system
culturalTips.content: The water system of Lijiang Old Town draws water from Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and flows through the city. Visitors should not wash things or discard litter in the canals. In winter, the water freezes, offering a unique scenery.

culturalTips.title: Naxi taboos
culturalTips.content: The Naxi people have some traditional taboos: don't step on the stove with your feet, don't linger in front of a maternity room, and don't sing Naxi love songs inside a home. These taboos are gradually fading, but respect is still necessary.

culturalTips.title: Bargaining for purchases
culturalTips.content: Bargaining in the old town is part of the culture. Usually, you can negotiate down to 40-60% of the marked price. Start with friendly conversation and keep smiling to build a good rapport.

culturalTips.title: Tibetan cultural influence
culturalTips.content: Lijiang is close to Tibetan areas and is significantly influenced by Tibetan culture. Around Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, there are Tibetan Buddhist temples and prayer wheels; please remain quiet and respectful.

culturalTips.title: Lijiang nightlife
culturalTips.content: The old town has a bar street at night, but after 10 PM, please lower your volume and avoid disturbing the residents. Naxi elders need to maintain an early-to-bed, early-to-rise lifestyle.

culturalTips.title: Dongba religion beliefs
culturalTips.content: The Naxi people follow Dongba religion, which is centered on nature worship. Please respect Dongba priests and do not disturb them when they are conducting religious activities in the old town.

culturalTips.title: History of the ancient city water system
culturalTips.content: The water system of Lijiang Old Town draws water from Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and was designed by the Mu family chieftains in the Ming Dynasty. It served three functions: irrigation, fire prevention, and daily use, reflecting the wisdom of the Naxi people.

culturalTips.title: Naxi brocade culture
culturalTips.content: The Naxi people have a fine tradition of brocade weaving, and the Naxi women's 'wearing stars and moon' attire is a famous symbol. You can bargain when buying brocade products, but please respect the value of the craftsmanship.

culturalTips.title: Mosuo matriarchal society
culturalTips.content: The Mosuo people around Lugu Lake maintain a matriarchal social system where families are centered on women. Under the walking marriage custom, men visit at night and leave at dawn, and children are raised by the mother's family.

culturalTips.title: Lijiang rose industry
culturalTips.content: Lijiang's rose industry is well-developed, with rose cakes, rose sugar, and rose wine as signature products. Edible roses are grown at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and are of excellent quality.

culturalTips.title: Religious significance of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
culturalTips.content: In the Naxi language, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain means 'Heavenly Mountain' and is the embodiment of Sanduo, the protector god of the Naxi people. There are Tibetan Buddhist temples on the mountain, with prayer wheels and prayer flags as common elements.

culturalTips.title: Safety for hiking Tiger Leaping Gorge
culturalTips.content: Hiking Tiger Leaping Gorge carries certain risks, and mudslides may occur during the rainy season from July to August. Please stay on the designated trails and do not leave them to enter undeveloped areas. It is recommended to hire a local guide.

culturalTips.title: Naxi handicrafts
culturalTips.content: Naxi tie-dye, Dongba woodcarving, and silver ornaments are the main handicrafts. When purchasing, look for works by artisans to avoid machine-made products.

culturalTips.title: Traditional curing of cured pork ribs
culturalTips.content: Cured pork ribs are a famous Lijiang dish, made by curing pork ribs with salt and spices before air-drying. The traditional method requires curing for over a month to develop the unique flavor.

culturalTips.title: Preservation of Naxi ancient music
culturalTips.content: Naxi ancient music is a UNESCO intangible cultural heritage, performed and passed down by elderly Naxi people. These pieces originate from the Tang Dynasty, some of which have been lost in central China but preserved in Lijiang.

culturalTips.title: Health at high altitude in Lijiang
culturalTips.content: Lijiang is at an altitude of 2,400 meters, and some visitors may experience altitude sickness. Drink plenty of water, avoid strenuous exercise, and seek medical attention immediately if you have severe headaches or breathing difficulties.

culturalTips.title: Trade on the Ancient Tea Horse Road
culturalTips.content: Lijiang was once an important hub on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, where caravans traveled to Tibet and Southeast Asia. The Sifang Street in the old town was the market where caravans traded.

culturalTips.title: Naxi silk tradition
culturalTips.content: The Naxi people have a tradition of sericulture and silk weaving. The 'Pixie Daiyue' seven-star cape in Naxi attire is made from self-woven fabric. This traditional craft is now being revived.

culturalTips.title: Mosuo Pig-trough Boat
culturalTips.content: The pig-trough boat of Lugu Lake is a traditional Mosuo watercraft, carved from a single log. Taking a boat trip on the lake is the best way to experience Lugu Lake.

culturalTips.title: Photography Etiquette for Snow Mountains
culturalTips.content: The best time to photograph Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is early morning, when there are fewer clouds and you can see the full peak. The summit is often shrouded in clouds, so please be patient.

culturalTips.title: The Origin of Flower Cakes
culturalTips.content: Flower cakes are a specialty snack of Lijiang, made from fresh rose petals and flour. They became popular during the Qianlong period of the Qing Dynasty and were a portable staple for caravan drivers on the Tea Horse Road.

culturalTips.title: Naxi Family Structure
culturalTips.content: Traditional Naxi families are matriarchal, with women primarily responsible for household chores and farming. Men handle crafts and lead horse caravans, a division of labor that continues to this day.

culturalTips.title: The Creation of Impression Lijiang
culturalTips.content: "Impression Lijiang" is directed by the renowned filmmaker Zhang Yimou and performed live at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. All 500 performers are local Naxi and other ethnic minorities.

culturalTips.title: Lijiang's Medicinal Herb Culture
culturalTips.content: Lijiang is an important producer of medicinal herbs in Yunnan, including gastrodia, notoginseng, and cordyceps. When purchasing herbs, please go to reputable shops and be careful to distinguish genuine products from fakes.

culturalTips.title: Naxi Roast Pork Tradition
culturalTips.content: Naxi roast pork is made by grilling strips of pork over charcoal, making it an excellent accompaniment to alcohol. Traditionally, it is slow-roasted over pine charcoal in the wild, but now it is available in restaurants throughout the old town.

culturalTips.title: Preservation of Ancient City Architecture
culturalTips.content: The buildings in Lijiang's old town are wooden structures, some of which are centuries old. Please do not use open flames or smoke inside these ancient buildings, and help protect this World Heritage site.

culturalTips.title: Tsampa Culture of Highland Barley
culturalTips.content: Tsampa is a staple food for Tibetans and Naxi people, made from roasted highland barley ground into flour. It is eaten by mixing the flour into butter tea, providing high-calorie sustenance in the highlands.

culturalTips.title: The Status of Mosuo Women
culturalTips.content: Mosuo society is centered around women, with family property inherited through the female line. The eldest woman in the household manages family affairs, while men take on the role of uncles, assisting in raising their nephews and nieces.

culturalTips.title: Yak meat cuisine
culturalTips.content: Yak are raised in the highland pastoral areas around Lijiang, making yak meat a local specialty. Highland yaks grow slowly, resulting in firm, protein-rich meat that is a healthy ingredient.

culturalTips.title: Naxi Dongba script
culturalTips.content: Dongba script is the only pictographic writing system still in use in the world, with over 1,400 characters. In the old town, you can learn to write Dongba script and create a unique souvenir.

culturalTips.title: Lijiang weather tips
culturalTips.content: Lijiang's weather changes quickly, and you may experience all four seasons in a single day. The rainy season (June-August) often brings heavy rain, while the snowy season (December-February) sees snow on Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Check the weather forecast before traveling.

attractions.name: 丽江古城
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage site featuring 800 years of Naxi culture, intricate water system with bridges and canals, and traditional wooden architecture.
attractions.ticketPrice: Free (50¥ reconstruction fee for some areas)
attractions.tips: Stay overnight to experience magical atmosphere. Arrive early morning before shops open for photos. Explore side alleys for authentic Naxi life. The old town is huge - get lost and explore. November-March is less crowded.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山
attractions.description: Sacred mountain of the Naxi people with 13 peaks, the highest at 5,596m. Features glaciers, alpine meadows, and stunning views visible from Lijiang.
attractions.address: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, 15km north of Lijiang
attractions.tips: Buy oxygen in town before going - expensive on mountain. Altitude sickness is real - take it slow. Book cable car tickets in advance. Go early to avoid clouds. Bring warm clothes even in summer.

attractions.name: 泸沽湖
attractions.description: Pristine alpine lake on the border of Yunnan and Sichuan, sacred to the Mosuo and Yi peoples. Known for its tranquil beauty and unique matriarchal culture.
attractions.tips: Stay overnight at lakeside guesthouse. Take boat tour at sunrise. Experience Mosuo 'walking marriage' culture. The road is winding - 4 hours from Lijiang. Best seasons: spring and autumn.

attractions.name: 虎跳峡
attractions.description: One of the world's deepest river canyons with dramatic 3,900m vertical drop, thundering Yangtze River, and legendary tiger-leaping rock.
attractions.address: Tiger Leaping Gorge, 60km north of Lijiang
attractions.tips: The hike is strenuous - fitness required. Best visited April-June and Sept-Nov. The road is dangerous - avoid cycling if inexperienced. Stay at guesthouses along the trail. Local guides recommended.

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.description: Less touristy Naxi town compared to Lijiang Old Town, preserving authentic Naxi architecture and traditional way of life. Also called 'Three Lanes' town.
attractions.tips: Visit in early morning or evening to avoid day-trippers. The tea house culture is authentic. Good for buying Naxi handicrafts without tourist markups. Combine with nearby Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.

attractions.name: 黑龙潭
attractions.description: Historic Naxi garden with the iconic view of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain reflected in the pond. Features traditional Naxi architecture and cultural performances.
attractions.tips: Best photo spot in Lijiang at sunrise when mountain reflection is clear. Naxi ancient music show at 13:30-14:30 and 15:30-16:30 (weather permitting). Bring ID for free entry.

attractions.name: 木府
attractions.description: The former residence of the Naxi overlords who ruled Lijiang for 470 years. Known as the 'Mini Forbidden City' for its imperial-style architecture.
attractions.tips: Arrive early to avoid tour groups. The audio guide is worth it for history. The roof offers best Old Town views. Allow time for the whole compound.

attractions.name: 望楚湖
attractions.description: A scenic plateau lake near Lijiang offering serene views of surrounding mountains, less crowded alternative to major attractions.
attractions.tips: Less visited by tourists. Road is rough - 4WD recommended. Best in autumn. High altitude - take precautions. Authentic Tibetan culture experience.

attractions.name: 丽江标点观景台
attractions.description: The most famous photo location in Lijiang Old Town featuring the emblem with traditional Naxi architecture and Jade Dragon Mountain backdrop.
attractions.address: Tuo Shui Lane, Lijiang Old Town
attractions.tips: Best at sunrise before crowds. Bring tripod for night shots. The spot is small - patience needed for photos without people.

attractions.name: 蓝月谷
attractions.description: A beautiful glacial valley with bright turquoise waters originating from Jade Dragon Snow Mountain's melting glaciers.
attractions.address: Blue Moon Valley, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area
attractions.tips: Electric car from Glacier Park to Blue Moon Valley included. The water is freezing cold - don't wade in. Best photos from the bridge. Combine with Snow Mountain in same day.

attractions.name: 牦牛坪
attractions.description: High altitude meadow at 3,600m offering closest views of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain peaks and Tibetan yak grazing pastures.
attractions.address: Yak Meadow, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
attractions.tips: Higher altitude than Glacier Park - more oxygen. Yak are large but usually docile. Respect local Tibetan culture. Morning visits have clearer skies.

attractions.name: 丽江古城水系
attractions.description: The ancient water system that gives Lijiang its nickname 'Venice of the East' with streams running through the entire old town.
attractions.tips: The water comes from Jade Dragon Mountain. Take a boat tour (50-100¥) for different perspective. The streams freeze in winter - charming sight. Don't swim or wash in canals.

attractions.name: 纳西古乐会
attractions.description: Traditional Naxi ancient music performances, some said to date back 1,000 years, performed by elderly musicians in historic venues.
attractions.tips: Book through hotel or directly at venue. The show in Black Dragon Pool area is most famous. Performances are cultural, not entertainment. Arrive early.

attractions.name: 文笔峰
attractions.description: A dramatic limestone peak visible from Lijiang, sacred to local Naxi and Tibetan peoples with ancient temples at its base.
attractions.tips: Less visited by tourists. The temples at base are authentic. Trekking is moderate difficulty. Go with local guide. Best light for photos in morning.

attractions.name: 拉市海
attractions.description: A scenic highland lake and wetland reserve popular for horse riding, boat tours, and bird watching, with Naxi and Yi villages nearby.
attractions.tips: Be careful of overcharging by horse guides - bargain hard. The horse ride through Yi villages is unique. Winter brings migratory birds. The boat tour is relaxing.

attractions.name: 玉湖村
attractions.description: Traditional Naxi village at foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, known for its stone houses, trout fishing, and Joseph Rock's former residence.
attractions.tips: Quiet village escape from old town crowds. Joseph Rock was a famous botanist who lived here. Try local trout dish. The stone houses are unique.

attractions.name: 东巴谷
attractions.description: Cultural theme park showcasing Naxi Dongba culture, including traditional crafts, calligraphy, and the only surviving pictographic writing system.
attractions.tips: Morning visits for live performances. Try writing your name in Dongba script. The wedding show is popular. Good for learning about Naxi culture.

attractions.name: 永灵古城镇
attractions.description: An ancient city with over 1,500 years of history, featuring well-preserved architecture from Tang, Song, and Ming dynasties.
attractions.tips: Off the beaten path - few tourists. Combine with road trip. The local market is colorful on 3rd, 8th, 13th, 18th, 23rd, 28th of lunar month. Authentic ancient China experience.

attractions.name: 沙溪黄山路
attractions.description: A historic tea-horse road route near Shaxi featuring ancient bridges, temples, and landscapes unchanged for centuries.
attractions.tips: The tea horse road history is fascinating. Cycling is the best way to explore. The road connects Shaxi to Lijiang historically. Bring snacks and water.

attractions.name: 终极牧场
attractions.description: A pristine alpine meadow near Lugu Lake offering stunning views, Tibetan nomad experiences, and star-filled night skies.
attractions.tips: High altitude - bring oxygen. Stay overnight for star experiences. The nomad camps offer authentic homestays. Best accessed by local guide. Summer has wildflowers.

attractions.name: 五一街
attractions.description: The main pedestrian street in Lijiang Old Town with shops, restaurants, bars, and traditional Naxi architecture.
attractions.tips: Great for evening strolls. Try local snacks like rose cake and yak meat. The bars have live music. Compare prices before buying. Negotiate at smaller shops.

attractions.name: 印象丽江
attractions.description: Epic outdoor performance directed by Zhang Yimou at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, featuring 500 local actors and ethnic culture.
attractions.address: Ganzi Village, near Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
attractions.tips: Book through hotel or tour desk. Weather dependent - may cancel in rain. Bring jacket even in summer. Arrive 30 min early.

attractions.name: 方广古镇
attractions.description: Well-preserved ancient town from the Tang Dynasty featuring Buddhist temples, old bridges, and traditional architecture.
attractions.tips: Off the beaten path. The temple is active with monks. Combine with nearby hot spring. Authentic ancient China feel.

attractions.name: 沙河酒庄
attractions.description: Mountain village famous for producing Yunnan highland wine, with vineyards, traditional wine cellars, and tasting experiences.
attractions.tips: Best for wine enthusiasts. Book tasting in advance. The wine is unique - fruity and smooth. Buy some to take home.

attractions.name: 黑龙古寺
attractions.description: Ancient Naxi Buddhist temple perched on a hill with panoramic views of Lijiang Old Town and Jade Dragon Mountain.
attractions.tips: Best at sunrise when mountain is visible. The climb takes 15 minutes. Ancient trees are impressive. Very quiet mornings.

attractions.name: 丽江古乐团
attractions.description: Famous performance venue for traditional Naxi ancient music, featuring musicians some over 80 years old.
attractions.tips: Book at hotel or directly. The music is ancient - expect traditional sounds. Arrive early for good seats. Cultural experience.

attractions.name: 巴巴藏族古道
attractions.description: Ancient hiking trail connecting Tibetan villages with stunning mountain views, prayer flags, and authentic culture.
attractions.tips: Hiking experience required. Local guide recommended. Bring water and snacks. Best in autumn. The trail is ancient.

attractions.name: 纳西扎染博物馆
attractions.description: Museum and workshop showcasing traditional Naxi tie-dye techniques with hands-on experience opportunities.
attractions.tips: Book ahead for workshop. Make your own tie-dye item to take home. The patterns are traditional Naxi designs. Good activity for rainy days.

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.description: Shuhe Ancient Town is one of the earliest settlements of the Naxi people. It is quieter and more primitive than Dayan Ancient Town, with babbling streams and numerous ancient bridges. It preserves the traditional Naxi way of life and is an ideal place to experience Naxi culture.
attractions.address: Shuhe Town, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: It is much quieter than Dayan Ancient Town, perfect for a leisurely stroll. In the evening, there is a bonfire party where you can dance with the Naxi people.

attractions.name: 白沙古镇
attractions.description: Baisha Ancient Town is the birthplace of the Naxi Mu family and the oldest ancient town in Lijiang. It retains a large number of traditional Naxi buildings and Baisha murals, making it an important window into Naxi history and culture.
attractions.address: Baisha Town, Yulong County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: The Baisha Murals are treasures of Ming Dynasty mural art and are well worth a close look. The old town features Naxi hand embroidery.

attractions.name: 白沙壁画
attractions.description: The Baisha Murals are religious murals painted by Han, Tibetan, and Naxi artists commissioned by the Naxi chieftain Mu of the Ming Dynasty. They blend multiple religious cultures and are one of Lijiang's most important cultural heritages.
attractions.address: Baisha Murals, Baisha Town, Yulong County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: Photography is not allowed in the mural hall. It is recommended to hire a guide to explain the stories and cultural significance of the murals.

attractions.name: 万古楼
attractions.description: Wangu Tower is located atop Lion Hill in Lijiang Old Town, the highest point of the old town. Climbing to the top offers a panoramic view of the entire old town and the distant Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, making it the best spot for panoramic photos of Lijiang.
attractions.address: Lion Hill, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
highlights: Panoramic view of the old town
attractions.tips: It is recommended to go in the evening to see the old town's night views and the sunset over the snow mountain. The tower houses a Naxi culture exhibition.

attractions.name: 四方街
attractions.description: Sifang Street is the central square of Lijiang Old Town and the busiest area. Every day, Naxi elders gather here to dance in a circle. The surrounding streets are lined with shops, making it the core area to experience life in Lijiang Old Town.
attractions.address: Sifang Street, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: It is most lively in the evening, where you can watch the Naxi people's traditional dance performances. There are many local snacks around Sifang Street.

attractions.name: 玉峰寺
attractions.description: Yufeng Temple is located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and is famous for a 500-year-old ancient camellia tree in the temple. This 'Ten Thousand Camellias' tree blooms over ten thousand flowers each year and is hailed as the 'Number One Tree in the World,' making it one of Lijiang's most renowned natural wonders.
attractions.address: Baisha Town, Yulong County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: The camellia blooming season is from February to April each year, which is the best time to visit. There are lamas residing in the temple.

attractions.name: 文峰寺
attractions.description: Wenfeng Temple is the largest Buddhist temple in Lijiang, located halfway up Wenbi Mountain. It is the highest institution of the Kagyu school in northwestern Yunnan. The temple houses the largest Buddha statue and exquisite murals in Lijiang, making it an important place to learn about Lijiang's Buddhist culture.
attractions.address: Wenbi Mountain, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: The temple environment is serene and suitable for quiet contemplation. It can be visited together with Wenbi Mountain.

attractions.name: 老君山
attractions.description: Laojun Mountain is an important part of the Three Parallel Rivers World Natural Heritage site, known for its Danxia landforms and alpine rhododendron seas. It is called the 'Ancestor of All Mountains in Yunnan' and is an excellent destination for hiking and photography.
attractions.address: At the junction of Yulong County and Jianchuan County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: The best time to visit is from May to June when the rhododendrons are in full bloom. It is far from downtown Lijiang, so self-driving or chartering a car is recommended.

attractions.name: 长江第一湾
attractions.description: The First Bend of the Yangtze River is located in Shigu Town, Lijiang. Here, the Jinsha River suddenly turns to form a V-shaped bend, making it one of the most spectacular natural landscapes in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River and a strategically important military location.
highlights: Red Army Long March Ferry Crossing
attractions.tips: The observation deck offers a panoramic view of the bend. It can be visited together with Tiger Leaping Gorge. Self-driving is the most convenient.

attractions.name: 云杉坪
attractions.description: Yunshanping is a high-altitude meadow halfway up Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, surrounded by pristine spruce forests. Wildflowers bloom across the meadow, and it is the legendary site of lovers' suicides in Naxi folklore, known as the 'Third Kingdom of Jade Dragon'.
attractions.address: Within the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, Lijiang
attractions.ticketPrice: Included in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain ticket (cable car charged separately)
attractions.tips: Reach it via the Yunshanping Cable Car. The meadow is at high altitude, so be mindful of altitude sickness.

attractions.name: 玉龙雪山冰川公园
attractions.description: The Glacier Park of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is the core attraction of the mountain. Taking the large cable car to the glacier park at an altitude of 4,506 meters allows you to view the spectacular glaciers and snow peaks up close, making it the most awe-inspiring natural experience in Lijiang.
attractions.address: Within the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, Lijiang
attractions.tips: The altitude is high, so it's recommended to take Rhodiola in advance. Bring warm clothing as temperatures at the summit are very low. The large cable car requires advance reservation.

attractions.name: 泸沽湖摩梭文化
attractions.description: The Mosuo people by Lugu Lake are China's last matriarchal society, retaining the unique 'walking marriage' custom. Visitors can learn about the Mosuo lifestyle, religious beliefs, and traditional culture, making it an excellent opportunity to experience ethnic minority culture.
attractions.address: Lugu Lake Town, Ninglang County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: You can join the Mosuo bonfire party and experience the walking marriage culture. Respect local customs and habits.

attractions.name: 虎跳峡观景石
attractions.description: Tiger Leaping Gorge viewing stone is the most famous attraction in Tiger Leaping Gorge. Legend has it that a tiger jumped across the Jinsha River by stepping on this boulder. Standing on the viewing stone, you can feel the surging power of the Jinsha River up close.
attractions.address: Tiger Leaping Gorge Scenic Area, Yulong County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: The viewing platform is very close to the Tiger Leaping Stone, where you can hear the roar of the river. Pay attention to safety and do not cross the guardrails.

attractions.name: 黑龙潭龙王庙
attractions.description: The Dragon King Temple at Black Dragon Pool, built during the Qing Dynasty, is located within Black Dragon Pool Park. It is a place for worshipping the Dragon King. The temple's architecture is simple and elegant, complementing the lake and mountain scenery of Black Dragon Pool, and it is an important part of Lijiang Old Town.
attractions.address: Inside Black Dragon Pool Park, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: You can visit together within Black Dragon Pool Park, where you can see the reflection of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain on the lake.

attractions.name: 纳西族村落
attractions.description: Around Lijiang, several traditional Naxi villages are preserved, retaining the most primitive lifestyle and architectural style of the Naxi people. Visitors can deeply experience the daily life and traditional culture of the Naxi people.
attractions.address: Lijiang Old Town and surrounding areas
attractions.tips: It is recommended to hire a local guide for a deeper understanding of Naxi culture. Respect local customs.

attractions.name: 玉湖骑马
attractions.description: Yuhu Lake is located at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, an excellent spot to view the mountain. Visitors can ride horses here, crossing meadows and forests, and enjoy the magnificent scenery of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain up close.
highlights: Horse riding to view the snow mountain
attractions.tips: Agree on the price and route with the horse handler before riding. It is recommended to wear long pants and sports shoes.

attractions.name: 印象丽江
attractions.description: Impression Lijiang is a large-scale live performance directed by Zhang Yimou, set against the backdrop of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, featuring over 500 performers from ethnic groups such as Naxi and Yi, showcasing Lijiang's natural scenery and ethnic culture.
attractions.address: Ganhaizi, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, Lijiang
attractions.tips: The performance is held outdoors, so be sure to protect yourself from the sun and keep warm. It's recommended to purchase tickets in advance. You can visit it together with Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.

attractions.name: 狮子山
attractions.description: Lion Hill is a small hill within Lijiang Old Town, named for its lion-like shape. Atop the hill stand Wangu Tower and Lion Hill Park, offering the best panoramic views of the old town and serving as its highest point.
attractions.address: Lion Hill, Gucheng District, Lijiang City
attractions.ticketPrice: Free (Wangu Tower charges a separate fee)
highlights: Panoramic view of the old town
attractions.tips: It's best to go in the evening to catch the sunset and night views of the old town. The hill is dotted with ancient trees and offers a tranquil environment.

attractions.name: 牦牛坪索道
attractions.description: The Yak Meadow Cable Car leads to the high-altitude meadow of Yak Meadow on Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. With expansive views, you can see the thirteen peaks of the snow mountain in the distance. The meadow is adorned with wildflowers, and yaks graze leisurely, making it a paradise for photography enthusiasts.
attractions.address: Within the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area, Lijiang
highlights: Thirteen peaks of the snow mountain
attractions.tips: The altitude is high, so be mindful of altitude sickness. It's recommended to bring warm clothing and sunscreen. It's less crowded than the main cable car.

attractions.name: 白沙古街
attractions.description: Baisha Ancient Street is the main thoroughfare of Baisha Ancient Town, lined with numerous traditional Naxi buildings and handicraft workshops. The street is sparsely populated and rich in local life, making it an ideal place to experience authentic Naxi living.
attractions.address: Baisha Town, Yulong County, Lijiang City
attractions.tips: You can watch elderly Naxi people doing hand embroidery and purchase authentic Naxi handicrafts.

attractions.name: 束河古镇
attractions.description: A Naxi ancient town that is quieter than Dayan Ancient Town, featuring the Tea Horse Road Museum.
attractions.tips: More peaceful than Dayan.

attractions.name: 里务比岛
attractions.description: An island in Lugu Lake, home to a Tibetan Buddhist temple.
attractions.tips: Accessible by boat.
